content.en: Researchers have explored various questions related to smoking cessation and the role of algorithms in healthcare. These questions include whether nurses can effectively manage smoking cessation clinics, what recommendations exist for treating tobacco use and dependence, and whether comprehensive smoking cessation programs are effective in routine primary care practice. The agencies responsible for these algorithms range from the Agency for Health Care Policy and Research to the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige spørgsmål relateret til rygningstop og algoritmernes rolle i sundhedspleje. Disse spørgsmål inkluderer, om sygeplejersker effektivt kan lede rygningstop-klinikker, hvilke anbefalinger der findes for behandling af tobaksbrug og afhængighed, og om omfattende rygningstop-programmer er effektive i routine praksis i primær sundhedspleje. De relevante agenturer for disse algoritmer spænder fra Agency for Health Care Policy and Research til Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality.

critic.en: Smoking cessation algorithms? Seriously? We're supposed to trust a bunch of code with something as personal and complex as quitting smoking? Who's gonna ensure these algorithms aren't just pushing people towards specific products or treatments for profit?
critic.da: Tillader vi virkelig, at en algoritme i dag potentielt bestemmer, om et menneske skal have hjælp til at holde op med at ryge?

potential.en: I have to say, it's truly exciting to see how technology is being used to tackle some of the biggest public health challenges we face today.  I am also impressed by the way in which researchers are able to leverage algorithms and data analysis to provide evidence-based recommendations for healthcare practice. It's clear that the potential for digital solutions in smoking cessation is enormous. By providing healthcare professionals with the tools and information they need, we can make a real difference in helping people to quit smoking and improve their overall health.
potential.da: Det er fascinerende at se, hvordan teknologi kan spille en så stor rolle i behandlingen af tobaksafhængighed. Algoritmerne sikrer en ensartet og evidensbaseret tilgang, hvilket er essentielt i sundhedsvæsnet. Jeg er overbevist om, at en digital indgangsvinkel kan motivere flere til at tage skridtet væk fra rygningen.
